case.title: 知识用途筛选、去重与历史修订
case.description:
C02 recorded synthetic alert materials copied unchanged into new local identities; no asserted real-world authorization.
Real local PostgreSQL and Qdrant, real existing local embedding service reached by SSH tunnel, real analysis model reached by existing SSH adapter.
Original KB ingest/index and Case HTTP routes/services/storage; only authentication and model transport are adapted. Local general API connection is explicitly the developer role, unlike production aisoc_app.
One Case and one Run; no repeated model sampling. Known M01-A/M01-B remain deferred and model quality NOT_PASSED.
No vendor/ClickHouse calls configured; unavailable sources and untriggered branches retain actual meanings.
Historical card source is a new explicit synthetic fixture (2026-11-01); its assessment and human statement are test data, not genuine business history, authorization or truth. Current C02 materials remain unchanged.
One explicit historical feedback revision before this Run; old card retained and excluded from fresh retrieval. Curated applicability tags on one source-preserving method document. No automatic import.

case.title: Case/H HTTP 功能验收：人工核查修订与后轮调查
case.description:
Recorded C02 synthetic materials are copied unchanged into new local identities; earlier A/I judgments and tool receipts are not replayed.
Real local PostgreSQL, original HTTP routers/dependencies, Case/H services, executor, storage and GET responses are used.
Only get_current_user is replaced by an explicit test principal; this is not local login or end-user UI acceptance.
The model gateway factory uses the existing SSH transport and real model/tokenizer; local default model credential lookup is not exercised.
No vendor or ClickHouse connection is configured. Missing, failed and empty tool results retain their actual meanings.
Two Runs belong to one functional H revision chain with the existing per-Run limits; no repeated quality samples or unknown retries.
Human text is material-completeness review, not fabricated business authorization. Known model narrative issues remain NOT_PASSED.
